tracks.title: Python & Computer Science Foundations
tracks.description: Core programming, data structures, and model fundamentals needed before any AI system can be built reliably.

tracks.title: Backend & Data Systems
tracks.description: Relational modeling, APIs, security, concurrency, storage, ingestion, and coordination for production data planes.

tracks.title: Frontend & Realtime Delivery
tracks.description: Application boundaries, streaming, and bidirectional client-server experiences for AI interfaces.

tracks.title: AI & RAG Systems
tracks.description: Retrieval, evidence, context engineering, embeddings, chunking, OCR, storage, and evaluation for model-augmented applications.

tracks.title: Agent Systems
tracks.description: Controlled agents, harnesses, orchestration, patterns, frameworks, memory, observability, and cross-boundary collaboration.

tracks.title: Operations & Reliability
tracks.description: Deployment, recovery, model engineering, and evaluation infrastructure for running AI systems in production.

tracks.title: System Design & Capstone
tracks.description: Architecture decisions, full-stack integration, and the portfolio capstone that demonstrates end-to-end competence.

foundations.competency: Explain the RAG mental model and when retrieval is needed

models.competency: Describe tokens, vectors, attention, and training versus inference

prompt-foundations.competency: Write system instructions and evaluate prompt quality beyond preference

database-modeling.competency: Design normalized schemas with constraints and indexes for AI workloads

api-security.competency: Validate identity, enforce ownership, and handle secrets in API boundaries

database-security.competency: Apply least privilege, parameter binding, and row-level security

database-concurrency.competency: Detect and prevent lost updates, deadlocks, and race conditions

security.competency: Explain prompt injection as an authorization problem and tool boundaries

sources.competency: Build incremental ingestion with checkpoints and SSRF protection

ingestion.competency: Run idempotent ingestion with revision checks and rollback

coordination.competency: Use leases, fencing, outbox, and SKIP LOCKED correctly

product-delivery.competency: Design streaming UI state machines and citation rendering

sse-streaming.competency: Implement SSE reconnection, replay, and backpressure

websocket-streaming.competency: Implement WebSocket auth, envelopes, and flow control

ocr-document-ai.competency: Extract fields from scanned documents and validate OCR confidence

chunking.competency: Choose chunk boundaries and overlap for semantic retrieval

embeddings.competency: Validate embedding shape, migrate models, and compare similarity metrics

storage.competency: Compare vector, keyword, and document storage backends honestly

retrieval.competency: Combine dense and lexical search with fusion and reranking

evidence.competency: Assemble evidence under a token budget with citations

context-engineering.competency: Separate instructions, evidence, and tool output in context contracts

context-optimization.competency: Calculate context budgets and apply truncation vs compression

evaluation.competency: Calculate Recall@K, Precision@K, MRR and build evaluation datasets

evidence-applicability.competency: Explain eligibility versus authorization with revision-aware references

agent-harness.competency: Build a controlled agent loop with stop conditions and tool policy

adk-agents.competency: Distinguish agent behavior from fixed pipelines using ADK

langchain.competency: Compare runnable composition with agent loops

agent-patterns.competency: Choose ReAct, router, planner, supervisor, or evaluator-optimizer

agent-orchestration.competency: Model fan-out/fan-in, dependencies, and durable execution

langgraph.competency: Use StateGraph nodes, edges, reducers, and checkpoints

skills-layers.competency: Organize skills with progressive disclosure and versioning

agent-evaluation.competency: Evaluate agent trajectories, not just answers, with release gates

agent-observability.competency: Instrument traces, metrics, and audit records without leaking data

backend-agents.competency: Expose agent tools over HTTP with idempotency and rate limits

mcp-foundations.competency: Explain MCP tools, resources, prompts, and authorization

mcp-server-engineering.competency: Layer MCP servers with validation, errors, and human confirmation

a2a.competency: Distinguish A2A from MCP and REST for remote agent collaboration

live-agents.competency: Bound live agent memory and handle event-time versus processing time

voice-agents.competency: Design cascaded voice pipelines with turn detection and barge-in

model-engineering.competency: Distinguish model quality from inference reliability and record lineage

evaluation-engineering.competency: Partition datasets, calibrate judges, and report quality with performance

evaluation-libraries.competency: Choose Ragas, DeepEval, TruLens, Phoenix, or Promptfoo for the task

deployment-reliability.competency: Run health checks, rollouts, and disaster-recovery drills

architecture.competency: Defend interface boundaries and abstraction trade-offs

application-architecture.competency: Trace a request across components and define trust boundaries

fullstack.competency: Integrate retrieval, agents, and streaming into one application

portfolio-capstone.competency: Build, document, and secure a complete AI engineering portfolio project
